known.title: Select the screen rule for all supported web-app layouts
Gate: unrelated board read metadata is outside Scope

findings.body:
Raise: Functional.
Case: normal use - an existing client keeps its web app under `web/` or `frontend/` and adds a person-facing API.
The new selection checks only `apps/web`, so those clients receive no screen-review rule. Settled item 14 explicitly identifies all three supported locations, using their `package.json` files. Match that detection contract and cover the alternative locations in the prompt-delivery test.
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 2.
